topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I walked into the room, expecting the familiar burst of shouts and laughter, the sudden surge of warmth and company. The lights were dim, the air still, a quiet that seemed to stretch endlessly. The table lay bare, no colorful wrappings or balloons to catch the eye. A single, unlit candle stood solitary on the tabletop, its wick a silent whisper of a promise unfulfilled. I lingered, hoping to hear the scurry of feet or the muffled giggle, but the silence kept its hold, unyielding. The evening slipped away, a quiet, unnoticed shadow, leaving in its wake only an empty space where the memories should have been. I sighed, turned, and stepped back into the empty hall, the unspoken words hanging heavy in the air.
